children: Famed investor Michael Burry recently said he is taking on the role of senior advisor for a new short-focused investment fund at Minerva Investment Management.

Burry is teaming up with Lakshmi Ganapathi and her global team at Unicus Research, he revealed Tuesday in a social media post, praising Unicus for building a "formidable global reputation with hard-hitting credit analysis," noting that he looks forward to having a "front row seat" as the team launches their new fund.

This move marks a new professional chapter for the investor, who originally rose to global prominence by famously betting against the housing market ahead of the 2008 financial crisis. Burry had previously stepped back from traditional fund management when he closed his hedge fund, Scion Asset Management, in late 2025. Since that closure, he has been sharing his market insights and investment ideas through a paid Substack newsletter, also operating under the "Cassandra Unchained" pseudonym.

Unicus Research, the firm partnered with Minerva, specializes in providing short-selling research ideas to investors. Its published short recommendations have achieved notable gains across a number of high-profile targets, including Faraday Future Intelligent Electric
, according to its track record as of Jan. 23.
While its track record remains largely successful, the firm's worst call was a short bet on Oklo
, which resulted in a 54.29% loss. Additional losses over the years include a long position in Getty Images
(-33.05%) and initial short calls on Peloton

title: Michael Burry joins short-biased fund as senior advisor
